summary:
Frontend-only verification of the SA CoParents Align consolidation: the 'Legal Lens Review and Report to Court' is now the single Professional Legal Report; the older 12-section report UI is gone; the ProfessionalStatement submit block gains a 'submit-include-legal' checkbox only once the Legal Lens report is final/submitted; submitting attaches the Legal Lens PDF to the frozen packet and the judge page exposes it. All acceptance criteria pass.

(1) Pro on /joint/{rid}: exactly one legal-lens-card renders (LEGAL LENS badge, title 'Professional Legal Report'); zero legal-report-card in the DOM. The orphaned component file /app/frontend/src/components/ProfessionalLegalReportCard.jsx still exists on disk but is not imported anywhere (grep-clean) so it never mounts — safe to delete.

(2) Filling ProfessionalStatement (role Mediator, role_basis, process_summary, observations, next_steps, dynamic-score slider set to 5 via native input setter) and clicking statement-mark-ready-btn does NOT reveal submit-include-legal while lens status is still Draft. Confirmed absent (count=0).

(3) legal-lens-prepare-btn → /cases/{rid}/professional-report builder. Filling lens-signature_name='QA Court Pro' + lens-professional_summary + clicking lens-finalize-btn flips lens-status to 'Final'.

(4) Back on /joint/{rid} submit-include-legal is now present (count=1). Ticking submit-include-legal + submit-attest, clicking submit-to-court-btn (confirm dialog auto-accepted) → submission succeeds. Reload builder → lens-status shows 'Submitted to Court'.

(5) Judge login (t_pjudge_*@example.com, testpass123) → /court/case/{refId}: court-legal-report block renders ('LEGAL LENS Professional Legal Report v1 — certified, attached to this frozen submission SHA-256 56ccd1e2…'); court-legal-report-pdf link → GET /api/court-dashboard/packets/{packet_id}/legal-report.pdf → HTTP 200, content-type application/pdf, 48594 bytes.

(6) Pro redirects: /joint/{rid}/legal-report → /cases/{rid}/professional-report; /joint/{rid}/legal-report/sample → /cases/{rid}/professional-report.

(7) Public redirect (no auth): /samples/legal-report → /samples/professional-report.

(8) /samples page has no sample-view-link-legal-report; the top card is sample-view-link-professional-report only.
action_items: Optional cleanup: /app/frontend/src/components/ProfessionalLegalReportCard.jsx is now orphaned (no importers). Safe to delete to prevent future regression re-introducing legal-report-card.
critical_code_review_comments: CourtCase.jsx line 101: renders the anchor itself carrying data-testid='court-legal-report-pdf'. Tests must query the testid directly (not 'testid a'). Fine at runtime — noted for regression stability.

ProfessionalStatement submit block gates submit-include-legal on data.legal_lens?.status in ['final','submitted_to_court'] — matches the spec. After submission the checkbox stays visible (status becomes submitted_to_court); consider auto-checking + disabling it once the lens has already been attached to a frozen packet so a subsequent version submission cannot accidentally omit it.
ProfessionalLegalReportCard.jsx should be removed from the repo; grep shows zero importers so the file is dead code but still shipped in the JS bundle if webpack picks it up via some barrel export.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth testids are 'email-input' and 'password-input' (NOT 'auth-email' as prior iter_54 note incorrectly stated); submit is 'auth-submit-btn'. Judge case URL uses referral_id, not case_code: /court/case/{refId}. court-legal-report-pdf is on the <a> element directly — select the testid, don't chain ' a'. Legal Lens redirects are Navigate-based (SPA) so page.url reflects the new path after the goto/networkidle. To submit-to-court in Playwright, register page.on('dialog', d: d.accept()) BEFORE clicking submit-to-court-btn (window.confirm gate).
